label: IKEv2
notes: IKEv2, the IPsec control plane (RFC 7296): it negotiates and maintains the security associations whose data plane is esp and ah. Every message begins with the fixed 28-byte header of RFC 7296 section 3.1; what follows is a chain of type-length payloads, cleartext in IKE_SA_INIT and encrypted from IKE_AUTH onwards, and is not modelled. The locator covers both framings: on UDP port 500 the header immediately follows the UDP header, while on UDP port 4500 (NAT traversal, RFC 3948) four zero octets — the non-ESP marker — precede it; the marker check keeps UDP-encapsulated ESP sharing port 4500 out of the match. With the marker present the header starts four octets later, so the field offsets above are exact for port-500 packets. The two 8-byte SPIs exceed the 4-byte BPF load window and are excluded; endpoints are matched with host primitives instead. IKEv1/ISAKMP shares port 500 with a different header layout — the version byte tells the two apart.

fields.label: Next Payload
fields.description: Type of the first payload following the header; 0 means the header stands alone. Values 33-48 are the RFC 7296 section 3.2 table, the rest are IANA registrations (values 1-32 are reserved so IKEv1 payload codes never collide).

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Version byte packing the 4-bit major version in the high nibble and the 4-bit minor version in the low nibble: 0x20 is IKEv2 2.0, 0x10 the IKEv1/ISAKMP header that shares UDP port 500. A receiver supporting at most major version 2 answers a higher major version with an INVALID_MAJOR_VERSION notification.

fields.label: Exchange Type
fields.description: The exchange the message belongs to, which constrains its payload chain: the four core types IKE_SA_INIT, IKE_AUTH, CREATE_CHILD_SA and INFORMATIONAL of RFC 7296, plus IANA-registered extensions.

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: Header flags: Initiator is set in messages from the original IKE SA initiator (it also tells which of the two SPIs the sender chose), Response marks responses to a request with the same Message ID, and Version advertises the ability to speak a higher major version. The remaining five bits are reserved and sent as zero.

fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: Counter pairing requests with responses and catching replays: 0 for both IKE_SA_INIT messages, incremented once per subsequent exchange, reset to 0 when the IKE SA is rekeyed.

fields.label: Length
fields.description: Total message length in octets, header plus every payload; 28 for a bare header. On port 4500 the four-octet non-ESP marker is not part of the message and is not counted.

excluded.reason: 64-bit IKE SA initiator-chosen SPI; twice the 4-byte BPF load window, and the endpoints are already matched with host primitives
